source: Sentinel-1 SAR research models; Open-Meteo ECMWF rainfall and Copernicus GloFAS discharge
time_window_warning: Calendar-day experiments anchored at 00:00 UTC, not rolling forecasts from the current minute.
input_shift_warning: Training used historical CHIRPS observed rainfall. Live inference uses Open-Meteo ECMWF rainfall and modeled GloFAS discharge. Input-domain and forecast errors are not calibrated.
spatial_warning: Nearby GloFAS points are geographic proxies, not proven hydrological catchments.
area_warning: Research land and cropland hectare proxies assume SAR-candidate fractions apply uniformly to geographic cells and cropland. They are NOT estimated actual flooded hectares.
